description: translates a vague user request about Toyota herself into one precise instruction for toyota_mechanic
notes: Pure text translation, no action on the world and no ADW: it reads toyota_mechanic's README and Toyota's system prompt section about it, then rewrites the user's vague ask into one concrete instruction sentence in toyota_mechanic's own vocabulary. It never calls or routes to toyota_mechanic itself -- dispatch stays Toyota's job -- so there is no Bash and no adw_<name>.py. output_path is a small runtime directory, not readable_documents/reports, because the deliverable is a one-line instruction, not a finance document.
